label: def:dressed-particle
title: Dressed particle via shell-attachment morphism
html:
Definition. Dressed particle via shell-attachment morphism

Definition. Let P_{\mathrm{bare}} be a confined particle at level \ell (typically a bare nucleus, \ell = 2). Let S = (\{e_k\}, \iota, W_{\mathrm{bind}}) be an electron shell of multiplicity Z attached to it. The dressing morphism at S is the arrow in the confinement category:

  \mathrm{dress}_S\,:\;P_{\mathrm{bare}}\;\longrightarrow\;P_{\mathrm{dressed}}

This morphism sends P_{\mathrm{bare}} to the dressed particle:

  P_{\mathrm{dressed}}
  \;=\;
  \bigl(
    \mathrm{name}(P_{\mathrm{bare}}) \oplus \mathrm{name}(S),\;
    \ell,\;
    [\iota(K_{\mathrm{bare}}) \cdot W_{\mathrm{bind}}]_M,\;
    n_0 + Z
  \bigr)

Here \mathrm{name}(S) is the shell label, [\ \cdot\ ]_M denotes Markov equivalence, and the composite braid lives in H_{n_0 + Z}(q) via the cabling embedding.
